pages.text: $(bold)Premium field ration.$() Cooked chicken coated in Blaze extract.$(li)Never frosts over in your inventory$(li)Restores serious hunger, but does not replace other food$(li)Stockpile before the Nether severs in Phase 5
One cooked chicken, one pinch of Blaze powder. Tastes like regret and capsaicin. Keep water nearby.
